result.summary: Block shipping: the new constructor call breaks application startup with Starlette 1.0.

findings.title: Preserve the constructor supported by production dependencies
findings.body: Starlette 1.0 removed the autoescape constructor keyword, so this module-level call raises TypeError when routes are imported by triggarr/__main__.py, preventing startup. Dockerfile installs with `pip install .` without uv.lock, and pyproject.toml leaves FastAPI unconstrained; FastAPI supports Starlette 1.0+. The installed 0.52.1 still accepts the keyword and escapes correctly, masking the production compatibility failure. See the [Starlette constructor](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Kludex/starlette/1.0.0/starlette/templating.py) and [FastAPI release notes](https://fastapi.tiangolo.com/release-notes/#01330).
findings.recommendation: Retain the explicit jinja2.Environment(autoescape=True) passed through env=, which both versions support, and verify application imports with Starlette 1.0.

next_steps: Restore the compatible initialization and smoke-test startup with production-resolved dependencies.
